{{Otheruses|Helix}}
'''Helixell''' was a key [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] in [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]].

[[Ohwun De Maal/Legends|Ohwun De Maal]] and [[Chachi De Maal/Legends|Chachi De Maal]] once discovered a star with three dead planets, all of which were rich in Helixell. As of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], they were deciding whether to report their findings to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] or secretly claim the Helixell for themselves.
